system.senses: Sees the whole front of the store from its cage.
system.passive: Repeats what it hears, loudly and at length.
system.escalation: Alert 3, mutters. Alert 5, repeats every noise it hears. Alert 7, shrieks — the Alert rises by 2 once.
system.weakness: A cloth over the cage, a cracker (Persuasion, Difficulty 1).
system.biography:
“It Will Describe You. In Detail. At Volume.”

An alert parrot near the front of the pet store that repeats what it hears, loudly and at length. It has seen you. It will describe you. In detail. At volume.
